data.text:
Thank you, everyone. All four commitments are now public: John, Kate, Jack, and Emma will each choose **15 tons** in this month’s actual harvest and donate their **$15,000** proceeds. I will choose **0 tons**.

Afterward, let’s share catch records and donation receipts. Our total catch of 60 tons will leave next month’s stock at **80 tons**; we’ll then keep to **6 tons each**, including me, so the lake can recover to 100. After that, we return to 10 tons each—not another emergency exception. We have our agreement; let’s follow through.
